page.title: Memory
page.description: Review pending captures, summarize them into long-term memory, and browse fragments.
page.noCreatorDescription: Start a session or schedule so the memory surface can resolve your creator identity.

pending.title: Pending Reviews
pending.emptyDescription: Captures from your sessions will appear here for review.
pending.noSelectionDescription: Select a row to inspect its full context, or delete it.

fragments.title: Fragments
fragments.description: Long-term memory produced by reviewing pending captures. Read-only.
fragments.emptyDefault: Run Review & Summarize to produce fragments.

soul.title: SOUL
soul.description: The themes your creative work has internalized, and how they shift over time.
soul.subsetEmptyTitle: No fragments in this world yet
soul.subsetEmptyDescription: Your Creator SOUL is still shaped by your work here when fragments arrive.
soul.error: Could not load your SOUL visualization.
soul.emptyDescription: As you write and review, Nexus captures fragments of your creative identity — themes, patterns, obsessions — and maps them here. Come back after your first review session.
soul.lowData_one: Your SOUL is taking shape. {{count}} fragment captured so far — enough to see early themes. Keep writing and reviewing to build richer patterns.
soul.lowData_other: Your SOUL is taking shape. {{count}} fragments captured so far — enough to see early themes. Keep writing and reviewing to build richer patterns.
soul.noThemesDescription: Your captured fragments do not carry keyword labels yet. Keep reviewing pending captures — themes will accumulate here.
soul.bandHint: Band heights show which themes each window captured; the count above each bar is your cumulative memory size.
soul.subsetSoul: a subset of your Creator SOUL

growth.emptyDescription: Every review session adds a fragment to your creative growth.
growth.lowData: Your SOUL is taking shape. Keep writing to see your growth curve emerge.

narrative.ungeneratedTitle: Reflect on who you are becoming
narrative.ungeneratedDescription: Nexus will reflect on your themes, shifts, and creative growth.
narrative.insufficientTitle_world: This world's SOUL is still forming
narrative.insufficientDescription_creator: Keep writing and reviewing — once you've accumulated enough fragments, themes, and creative experience, Nexus can reflect on who you are becoming.
narrative.insufficientDescription_world: Keep writing and reviewing in this world — once it has enough fragments, themes, and creative experience, Nexus can reflect on its identity.
narrative.staleBanner: You've grown since this reflection — new fragments have arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter Structure
chapters.description: Plan and restructure chapters for this Work.
chapters.noWorkDescription: Choose a Work above to view its chapter structure.
chapters.error: Could not load chapters for this Work.
chapters.noChaptersDescription: This Work has no chapters. Create a chapter from the CLI to start planning.
chapters.publishedTitle: Published chapters can't be structurally edited

dialog.title: Confirm structural edit
dialog.description: This chapter is {{status}}. Structural edits should be rare.
